title: Skyscraper complex acyclicity preservation
statement: For a ringed space X, point x and stalk-module cochain complex M, if M is acyclic then its termwise ringed-module skyscraper complex is acyclic.

source.place: the sectionwise exactness argument in the proof of lem-pc-skyscraper-complex

proof.text: Unfold acyclicity degreewise into exactness of the associated short complex. Map it through the faithful zero-preserving composite SheafOfModules.forget followed by PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf; Functor.reflects_exact_of_faithful reduces the goal to exactness of the underlying abelian presheaf short complex.

On each open V, the skyscraper sections are functions PLift (x ∈ V) → M and the maps act pointwise. ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff applied to the original short complex supplies a preimage of each value of a section in the kernel; classical choice assembles these into a section. When x is absent the domain is empty and the same construction is vacuous. ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff gives exactness after evaluation at V.

Evaluation preserves homology in the abelian functor category. ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso transports the zero homology of every evaluated short complex to each component of presheaf homology. NatTrans.ext shows its identity is zero, so ShortComplex.exact_iff_isZero_homology gives presheaf exactness. Reflect exactness as above in every degree.

lean.statement:
theorem skyscraper_complex_acyclic (X : RingedSpace.{u_complex}) (x : X)
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u_complex} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ℤ) :
    M.Acyclic → (((ringedModuleSkyscraperFunctor X x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M).Acyclic
